mapper.sql: sales_orders.id AS id, sales_orders.order_date AS `date`, sales_orders.so_code AS soCode, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, sales_orders.memo AS memo, customers.id AS customerId, CONCAT_WS(' ', customers.customer_code, '-', customers.name) AS customerName, sales_orders.customer_contact_id AS customerContactId, sales_orders.total_amount AS totalAmount, sales_orders.balance AS amountDue, sales_orders.balance AS balance, sales_orders.payment_term_id AS paymentTermId, COALESCE(sales_orders.due_date, '') AS aging, DATE_FORMAT(sales_orders.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(sales_orders.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = sales_orders.branch_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = sales_orders.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = sales_orders.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, customers.address AS customerAddress, customers.main_number AS customerPhoneNumber, customers.customer_code AS customerAtt, DATE(NOW()) AS `date`, (SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE id = #{filter.userId}) AS prepareBy, (SELECT telephone FROM users WHERE id = #{filter.userId}) AS prepareByTel, (SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = #{filter.userId}) AS prepareByGmail FROM customers WHERE id = #{filter.organizationId}
mapper.sql: receive_payments.id AS id, (SELECT name FROM companies WHERE id = receive_payments.company_id) AS `companyName`, receive_payments.date AS `date`, receive_payments.reference AS reference, customers.name AS customerName, customers.id AS customerId, branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, customers.main_number AS customerTel, customers.address AS customerAddress, receive_payments.gl_id AS glId, CONCAT(receive_payments.account_codes, ' - ', receive_payments.account_description) AS chartAccountName, receive_payments.total_amount AS totalAmount, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so_code) FROM sales_orders WHERE id = receive_payment_details.sales_order_id) AS invoiceCode, receive_payments.note AS note, IFNULL(receive_payments.exchange_rate, 0) AS exchangeRate, receive_payments.cheque_number AS chequeNumber, CASE WHEN ((SELECT vat_percent FROM sales_orders WHERE id = receive_payment_details.sales_order_id) > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isVat, COALESCE((SELECT contact_name FROM customer_contacts WHERE id = receive_payments.customer_contact_id), '') AS attn, receive_payments.account_codes AS accountCode

FROM receive_payments LEFT JOIN receive_payment_details ON receive_payment_details.receive_payment_id = receive_payments.id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = receive_payments.customer_id LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = receive_payments.branch_id

WHERE receive_payments.is_active = 1

AND receive_payments.customer_id = #{filter.organizationId}
AND DATE(receive_payments.date) >= DATE(#{filter.dateFrom}) AND DATE(receive_payments.date) <= DATE(#{filter.dateTo})
